calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, f.channel_code, COUNT(*) line_count, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) distinct_lines, SUM(f.quantity) units, SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units, MIN(f.sale_date), MAX(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE p.sku=101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.store_key, f.product_key
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE p.sku=101624 AND s.store_id=131 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-26' AND DATE '2026-10-06'
ORDER BY f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.line_no

SELECT 'dup_line_id' chk, COUNT(*) n FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'rows_week', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'

WITH a AS (SELECT f.sale_date d, SUM(f.quantity) u, SUM(f.net_amount) n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) r FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.d, a.u fact_units, r.units_sold rpt_units, a.n fact_net, r.net_sales_before_returns rpt_net, a.r fact_receipts, r.receipts rpt_receipts
FROM a FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=131 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04') r ON r.business_date=a.d ORDER BY 1
